posts.text: The narrowest canyon in North America is still standing strong after 3 fires last year, and holds beauty that's inspired people for generations. Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park is the least visited National Park in Colorado. Last year during the fires, the South Rim had to close for 39 days; since the park brings $175,000/day to the local economy, that was a massive hit.
